title: Pending invitations minted by later-removed admin remain spendable (no delegator revocation cascade)
description: groups_collection.py:310-365 rekey pops/burns ONLY removed_member's own invitation identity; documents minted BY removed admin for others stay valid until expiry and grant CURRENT-epoch keys post-rotation. Spec 18.8.2 silent on outstanding grants; compensating control = owner individually removes each delegatee. Spec-owner decision required (cascade burn vs accept-with-documentation).
